questions.question: What is the slope of the graph of y = 14(27x + 12) + 7x in the xy-plane?
In the xy−plane, which of the following does NOT contain any points that are part of the solution set to 7x − 6y > 42?
questions.explanation: If x < 0 and y > 0, then 7x − 6y is negative and can never exceed 42. The other regions contain solutions (e.g., (10, 0), (10, 1), (−1, −10)).

questions.question: In the figure shown, line k intersects lines r and s. If w = 147, which additional piece of information is sufficient to prove that lines r and s are parallel?
questions.explanation: Angles w and y are corresponding angles; if both equal 147° then lines r and s are parallel.

x + 4y = −3
4x − y = 22
The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of 3x − 5y?
questions.explanation: From the second equation y = 4x − 22; substituting gives 17x − 88 = −3, so x = 5 and y = −2. Then 3(5) − 5(−2) = 25.

questions.question: A piece of string with a length of 30 inches is cut into two parts. One part has a length of x inches, and the other part has a length of y inches. The value of x is 3 more than 2 times the value of y. What is the value of x?
questions.explanation: x + y = 30 and x = 2y + 3, so 3y + 3 = 30, y = 9 and x = 21.

questions.question: The graph of the polynomial function f is shown, where y = f(x). What is the value of f(5)?
questions.explanation: The graph crosses the x-axis at x = 5, so f(5) = 0.

questions.explanation: Distribute the minus sign: 9c + 8 − 4c^3 + 6 = −4c^3 + 9c + 14.

The function g(t) = 297 + (363 − 297)(2.72)−0.103t gives the approximate temperature, in kelvins, of the liquid t minutes after the beaker was placed on the table. According to this function, what was the approximate temperature, in kelvins, of the liquid when the beaker was placed on the table?
questions.explanation: At placement t = 0, so g(0) = 297 + 66(1) = 363 kelvins.

questions.question: The positive number a is 2,800% of the number c, and c is 25% of the number b. If a − b = wc, where w is a constant, what is the value of w?
questions.explanation: a = 28c and b = 4c, so a − b = 24c and w = 24.

questions.question: Parallel lines m and n are cut by a transversal t. One interior angle on line m measures (4x − 10)°, and the interior angle on line n on the same side of t measures (2x + 10)°. What is the measure of the acute angle that t makes with the parallel lines?
Line k is defined by 7x + 11y − 8 = 0. Line j is perpendicular to line k in the xy−plane. What is the slope of line j?
questions.explanation: Line k has slope −7/11, so a perpendicular line has the negative reciprocal slope, 11/7.

questions.question: The graph of the linear function f is shown, where y = f(x). Which equation defines f?
questions.explanation: The line passes through (0, −1) and (8, −6), so the slope is (−6 − (−1))/(8 − 0) = −5/8.

questions.question:
x + y = 165
x + y + y = 185
The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of y?
questions.explanation: Subtracting the first equation from the second gives y = 185 − 165 = 20.

questions.question: Line p is defined by y = 6x − 8. Line s is parallel to line p in the xy-plane. What is the slope of line s?
questions.explanation: Parallel lines have equal slopes, so the slope of line s is 6.

questions.question: If x + 4y = 31 and 9x − 20y = −57, what is the value of y?
questions.explanation: Multiply the first equation by 5 and add to the second: 14x = 98, so x = 7. Then 7 + 4y = 31 gives y = 6.

questions.question: The equation 2|x − 5| = k, where k is a constant, has exactly one solution. Which of the following could be the value of k2?
questions.explanation: An absolute value equation has exactly one solution only when it equals 0, so k = 0 and k/2 = 0.

questions.question: A machine fills bags with approximately 11 ounces of sugar. To test the accuracy of the filling process, 132 bags of sugar were selected at random and weighed. Based on the sample, it is estimated that the average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine in an 8-hour period is 10.83 ounces, with an associated margin of error of 0.2 ounce. Which of the following is the best interpretation of this estimate?
options: Plausible values for the average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine are between 10.63 ounces and 11.03 ounces.
Plausible values for the average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine are less than 10.63 ounces or greater than 11.03 ounces.
The average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine is greater than 10.98 ounces.
The average weight of all bags of sugar filled by the machine is less than 10.98 ounces.
questions.explanation: 10.83 ± 0.2 gives the interval 10.63 to 11.03 ounces.

questions.question:
A researcher is designing a study to investigate the average number of hours students at a high school spend reading per day. The researcher will report an estimated average number of hours students at the high school spend reading per day with an associated margin of error. The researcher is considering using a random sample of either 105 or 210 students from the high school.
Which of the following would be the most likely effect of using the larger random sample compared to the smaller random sample?
options: The reported margin of error would be lower.
The reported margin of error would be higher.
The reported average number of hours would be lower.
The reported average number of hours would be higher.
questions.explanation: A larger random sample reduces the margin of error. It does not systematically raise or lower the estimated average.

questions.question: The perimeter of an obtuse triangle is 27 meters. The lengths of two sides of this triangle are 5 meters and 9 meters. What is the length, in meters, of the third side of this triangle?
questions.explanation: The third side is 27 − 5 − 9 = 13 m, and 13^2 > 5^2 + 9^2, so the triangle is obtuse.

questions.question: A rectangle has a length that is 72 times its width. The function y = (72w)(w) represents this situation, where y is the area, in square feet, of the rectangle and y > 0. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 72w in this context?
options: The length of the rectangle, in feet
The area of the rectangle, in square feet
The difference between the length and the width of the rectangle, in feet
The width of the rectangle, in feet
questions.explanation: The length is 72 times the width w, so 72w is the length in feet.

questions.question:
2cos(90 − a)° · cos b° + sin(a + y)° · sin(90 − b)°
In the given expression, a and b are constants such that sin a° = 0.50, cos b° = 0.99, and 0 < b < 90. What is the value of the given expression when y = 0?
questions.explanation: cos(90 − a)° = sin a° and sin(90 − b)° = cos b°. With y = 0 the expression is 2 sin a cos b + sin a cos b = 3(0.50)(0.99) = 1.485.

questions.question: In triangle RST, angle T is a right angle, point L lies on RS, point K lies on ST, and LK is parallel to RT. If the length of RT is 63 units, the length of LK is 21 units, and the area of triangle RST is 819 square units, what is the length of KT, in units?
questions.explanation: Area (1/2)(63)(ST) = 819 gives ST = 26. Triangles SKL and STR are similar with ratio 21/63 = 1/3, so SK = 26/3 and KT = 26 − 26/3 = 52/3.

questions.question: The equation 58 = 2x + 2y gives the perimeter of a rectangular garden that has length x, in feet, and width y, in feet. The width of the garden is 14 feet. What is the length, in feet, of the garden?
questions.explanation: Substituting y = 14 gives 58 = 2x + 28, so 2x = 30 and x = 15.
